sourceLabel: National Climate Change Plan for the Energy Sector
text: National Climate Change Plan for the Energy Sector. Input for the planning and improvement of the national energy system's operation, including all energy sources, their transformation and transport, to contribute to the sector's climate resilience and the pathway toward carbon neutrality.

sourceLabel: National REDD+ Strategy
text: National REDD+ Strategy. Contribute to the mitigation of global climate change through the reduction of deforestation and forest degradation, conservation of forest ecosystems, enhancement of forest carbon stocks, and sustainable forest management.

sourceLabel: National Technical Guide on Climate Change for the LULUCF...
text: National Technical Guide on Climate Change for the LULUCF (Forests) Sector. Increase forest cover and enhance carbon dioxide absorption capacity, restore degraded areas, reduce vulnerability, and strengthen adaptive capacity to climate change with improved provision of ecosystem services.

sourceLabel: Climate Change Plan for Integrated Watershed Management
text: Climate Change Plan for Integrated Watershed Management. Seeks the adaptation of watersheds, with emphasis on nature-based solutions. It also aims for emissions mitigation through reforestation, afforestation and soil restoration; conservation of forest carbon stocks; sustainable forest management; and increased carbon storage.

sourceLabel: Indicative Environmental Land-Use Plan (PIOTA) for the Pa...
text: Indicative Environmental Land-Use Plan (PIOTA) for the Panama Canal Watershed (CHCP). Seeks to guide economic, environmental protection and conservation activities in the Panama Canal Watershed (CHCP), and to achieve harmonization among applicable environmental management instruments.

sourceLabel: Technical Guide on Climate Change for the Marine-Coastal ...
text: Technical Guide on Climate Change for the Marine-Coastal Systems Sector. Through this technical guide, adaptation planning is to be integrated into the existing regulatory framework and planning instruments, implemented primarily through nature-based solutions (NbS).

sourceLabel: Net annual emissions balance in coastal wetlands (mangrov...
text: Net annual emissions balance in coastal wetlands (mangroves) applying Chapter 4 of the 2013 IPCC Wetlands Supplement.. Recognize the crucial role that blue carbon ecosystems play for the country and improve transparency in the inventories and reporting of emissions and removals.

sourceLabel: Manual of Restoration Techniques for Degraded Mangrove Areas
text: Manual of Restoration Techniques for Degraded Mangrove Areas. Seeks to strengthen knowledge on the restoration process for impacted mangrove areas and associated coastal-marine wetlands, which contribute enormously to the sequestration and storage of carbon dioxide as a fundamental pillar for reducing the impacts of sea-level rise and for safeguarding ocean quality.

sourceLabel: Climate Change Guide for the Biodiversity Sector
text: Climate Change Guide for the Biodiversity Sector. This commitment will represent a planning instrument for adaptation through the implementation of measures that reduce impacts on biodiversity, with strategies that decrease habitat vulnerability and fragmentation, increasing resilience to extreme climate events while protecting carbon stocks.

sourceLabel: National Climate Change Plan for the Agricultural Sector ...
text: National Climate Change Plan for the Agricultural Sector (PNCCSA).. Reduce vulnerability, increase resilience (adaptation), and reduce greenhouse gas emissions from the Agricultural Sector.

sourceLabel: Rice NAMA
text: Rice NAMA. Transformation of the economy toward low-carbon growth.

sourceLabel: Livestock NAMA
text: Livestock NAMA. Transformation of the economy toward low-carbon growth.

sourceLabel: Agro-climatic Information System for the Agricultural Sector
text: Agro-climatic Information System for the Agricultural Sector. The system facilitates information and data management to maximize the performance of the agro-climatic system and ensure the effectiveness of each of the various processes carried out.

sourceLabel: Technical Guide on Climate Change for Human Settlements
text: Technical Guide on Climate Change for Human Settlements. Seeks to increase the resilience of human settlements in the country and strengthen the participation of key stakeholders to plan, finance, implement, monitor and report on strategic adaptation processes, and to communicate knowledge on climate change adaptation, taking into consideration the benefits this would bring for mitigation.

sourceLabel: Reduce Your Municipal Footprint Program
text: Reduce Your Municipal Footprint Program. Develop carbon footprint management tools for local governments and support them in the process of measuring, reducing and offsetting their carbon footprint.

sourceLabel: Climate Change Plan for the Health Sector
text: Climate Change Plan for the Health Sector. Will expand planning instruments to reduce population vulnerability, focusing on strengthening epidemiological surveillance systems for environmental and climate risks that allow monitoring of emerging and re-emerging diseases linked to climate change, and will also indirectly contribute to emissions reduction through the implementation of various adaptation measures.

sourceLabel: Climate Change Plan for the Infrastructure Sector
text: Climate Change Plan for the Infrastructure Sector. Proposes a vision for developing infrastructure resilient to climate change impacts across multiple areas: drip irrigation, hydraulics for flood control, drinking water, sewerage, logistics (ports, roads, bridges, airports), and green buildings.

sourceLabel: Public Investment Projects with Integrated Climate Change...
text: Public Investment Projects with Integrated Climate Change Considerations. Aims to promote a comprehensive list of measures to identify the most relevant adaptation and mitigation solutions, implement them, and supervise them. Seeks to achieve the implementation of this Technical Guide within public investment projects, so that climate risks and the adaptation and mitigation processes to be considered can be identified and understood before the financing and execution of a project.

sourceLabel: Updated Regulation with Integrated Climate Risk Managemen...
text: Updated Regulation with Integrated Climate Risk Management, Adaptation Measures and Project Carbon Footprint Reduction. Update of Executive Decree 123 of 14 August 2009, the environmental management analysis methodology, and the elements, aspects and variables that may be caused by global warming, considering climate change as a vector that introduces changes to the environment, as well as the measurement of the project's carbon footprint.

sourceLabel: Executive Decree on Eco-Labeling
text: Executive Decree on Eco-Labeling. Modernization, restructuring and validation of Executive Decree No. 100 of 7 October 2008, which regulates the certification of environmentally clean products and services.

sourceLabel: Circular Economy Center
text: Circular Economy Center. Generate economic changes so that the country becomes efficient in resource conservation and sustainability practices, through the implementation of a model based on the Circular Economy, engaging the private sector in the development of the circular economy in Panama.

sourceLabel: Circular Economy Metrics and Indicators
text: Circular Economy Metrics and Indicators. Develop the metrics and indicators that enable tracking and monitoring of progress in the implementation of a circular economy and that support decision-making in this area.

sourceLabel: Reduce Your Corporate Footprint
text: Reduce Your Corporate Footprint. Develop carbon footprint management tools for public and private organizations, academia, civil society, etc. Recognize these organizations' efforts to measure, reduce and offset their carbon footprint.

sourceLabel: Long-Term National Climate Change Plan for the Circular E...
text: Long-Term National Climate Change Plan for the Circular Economy. Will expand planning instruments to reduce the sector's vulnerability to the effects of climate change, with the objective of integrating adaptation planning into the existing regulatory framework and planning instruments.

sourceLabel: Regulation on Environmental Audits and Environmental Mana...
text: Regulation on Environmental Audits and Environmental Management Program including Disaster Risk Management, Adaptation Measures and Carbon Footprint Reduction. Update of Executive Decree No. 57 of 10 August 2004, which regulates the evaluation process for Environmental Audits and the Environmental Adjustment and Management Program. This will include disaster risk management, adaptation measures, and carbon footprint reduction.

sourceLabel: SIRED Platform
text: SIRED Platform. Expand the SIRED platform to include slow-onset events such as desertification and land and forest degradation, biodiversity loss, salinization, sea-level rise, and ocean acidification.

sourceLabel: National Climate Transparency Platform
text: National Climate Transparency Platform. Management and monitoring of actions that lead toward carbon neutrality and sustainable, inclusive, low-emission and resilient development, through its components: National Greenhouse Gas System, National Registry for Mitigation Actions, National System for Adaptation Monitoring and Evaluation, and National Registry for Means of Implementation for Climate Action.
